== Ingredients ==

* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Oats|oats]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Liter|liters]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]] 

==Procedure==

# Put oats in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]]. Blend the oats to the finest powder you can get
# Add as much of the water as possible to the blender. Blend some more.
# Strain the mixture into a jug, and add the rest of the water.

== Notes, tips, and variations == 
*Stir the milk before consuming it.
*This will keep in the refrigerator at least a week.
*The blended oat solids can be used to make porridge.
